intent.proves: At least one active product has an active comment with a rating.
intent.scope: active comments of item type ecomProduct on active products; complete SQL enumeration

bindings.reason: get_comments can filter by item type; its response envelope and rating field are not measured.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Comment c WHERE c.CommentItemType = N'ecomProduct' AND c.CommentActive = 1 AND c.CommentRating > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = c.CommentItemId AND p.ProductActive = 1)

sources.ref: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/dynamicweb.ecommerce/10.29.8/dynamicweb.ecommerce.10.29.8.nupkg (product deletion removes Comment rows with CommentItemType 'ecomProduct')
